title: parkinzi
description: Live Saudi smart-parking data: spots, EV chargers, stats, and blog. Read-only, no auth.
summary: Live Saudi smart-parking data: spots, EV chargers, stats, and blog. Read-only, no auth.
offersHint: Live Saudi smart-parking data: spots, EV chargers, stats, and blog. Read-only, no auth. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://parkinzi.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search
toolsPreview.description: Search PARKINZI for parking spots, EV chargers, covered cities, and blog articles. Returns a list of results with id, title, and url. Use fetch with a result id to get the full record. Queries can be Arabic or English (e.g. 'مواقف الرياض', 'EV charging Jeddah').

toolsPreview.name: fetch
toolsPreview.description: Fetch the full content of a PARKINZI search result by its id (as returned by the search tool). Returns id, title, full text, url, and metadata.

toolsPreview.name: search_parking_spots
toolsPreview.description: Search live parking spots on PARKINZI by location, free-text query, or EV-charger filter. Returns up to 50 spots with name, coordinates, area, floor, type, and whether they offer EV charging.

toolsPreview.name: find_ev_chargers
toolsPreview.description: Locate EV charging spots near a coordinate. Optionally filter by charger type. Result includes charger_type and the spot location.

toolsPreview.name: get_spot_details
toolsPreview.description: Get the full record for a single parking spot by its UUID id. Includes coordinates, area, facility relationship, floor, charger info, and availability.

toolsPreview.name: get_platform_stats
toolsPreview.description: Live PARKINZI platform statistics: total parking spots, EV-charger spots, facilities, and registered users. Numbers come straight from the production database.

toolsPreview.name: list_supported_cities
toolsPreview.description: List Saudi cities/areas where PARKINZI has recorded parking spots, sorted by number of spots descending.

toolsPreview.name: search_blog_posts
toolsPreview.description: Search the PARKINZI blog for articles about smart parking, EV charging, Saudi cities, Vision 2030, and related topics. Returns titles, summaries, publish dates, and URLs.

toolsPreview.name: get_app_info
toolsPreview.description: Get core information about the PARKINZI app: download links, supported platforms, languages, contact email, and a one-paragraph description.
